**Position Summary :**
 This job is responsible for developing and delivering complex requirements to accomplish business goals. Key responsibilities of the job include ensuring that software is developed to meet functional, non\-functional and compliance requirements, and solutions are well designed with maintainability/ease of integration and testing built\-in from the outset. Job expectations include a strong knowledge of development and testing practices common to the industry and design and architectural patterns.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Codes solutions and unit test to deliver a requirement/story per the defined acceptance criteria and compliance requirements
* Designs, develops, and modifies architecture components, application interfaces, and solution enablers while ensuring principal architecture integrity is maintained
* Mentors other software engineers and coach team on Continuous Integration and Continuous Development (CI\-CD) practices and automating tool stack
* Executes story refinement, definition of requirements, and estimating work necessary to realize a story through the delivery lifecycle
* Performs spike/proof of concept as necessary to mitigate risk or implement new ideas
* Automates manual release activities
* Designs, develops, and maintains automated test suites (integration, regression, performance)
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of real\-time data replication solutions using IBM IIDR to support Never Down (NVD) initiatives.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of IIDR\-based pipelines across mainframe (z/OS) and midrange platforms, ensuring seamless integration with DB2, Kafka, and other target systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex replication issues, with a strong focus on reducing latency and ensuring high availability and resilience.
* Optimize performance of IBM IIDR CDC pipelines, including tuning throughput, subscription parallelism, and resource utilization.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, driving best practices in IIDR design, development, and support.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements, estimate effort, and deliver solutions aligned with business priorities.
* Ensure production stability by monitoring system health, proactively identifying risks, and implementing remediation strategies.
* Support testing, deployment, and release activities, including CI/CD processes and production readiness validations.
* Conduct root cause analysis for incidents and implement long\-term fixes to improve system reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation through proof\-of\-concepts, automation, and process enhancements.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience (Technical developer) in IBM IIDR (mainframe and midrange), focused on real\-time data replication, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting in data integration pipelines.
* Deep knowledge of IBM IIDR across z/OS (mainframe) and IIDR midrange (Linux/Red Hat) environments.
* Strong proficiency in z/OS and Unix technologies, including JCL, DB2 for z/OS, RACF security, and Unix shell scripting; well versed in IIDR\-to\-Kafka streaming architecture.
* Proven ability to tune IBM IIDR performance between source and target datastores (log readers, buffers, throughput optimization, and subscription parallelism).
* Hands\-on experience with IBM IIDR Access Server and Management Console configuration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with expertise in analyzing IBM IIDR logs, DB2 logs, Mainframe SYSLOG / JES logs,
* Skilled in analyzing: Network issues affecting replication; Communication/handshake issues; Serialization or conflict errors; Schema evolution problems across IBM IIDR and Confluent Kafka.
